title: Mate with bishop and knight

D0.outcome: Explains that bishop and knight mate only in the corner of the bishop's colour, in two phases.

D1.outcome: Drives the lone king to the edge and along it to the right corner in a given position.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, picks the correct corners and mates within the fifty-move limit using the standard method.

D3.outcome: Verifies the method against the tablebase and counts the moves.
